title: commands-find/1: the commands and Flow steps that do a task
description: The answer of `mzlab-cli commands --find WORDS... --json`: the task words kept (lower case, plural to singular, stop words dropped, s/n = snr, m/z = mz) and at most five matches, best first. A match is ranked by the words of its name, the task words of crates/mzlab-cli/src/catalog/related.rs, its summary (a step's title) and a step's doc, a word that many items carry counting less; a step that only the page runs counts half. Deterministic: the same words give the same bytes. No match: exit 5, `err.cli.find.none`. Code: crates/mzlab-cli/src/catalog/find.rs.

name.description: A command path (`peak table`) or a Flow step id (`chrom.transitions`).

summary.description: The summary of the command, the title of the step.

example.description: One command line; for a step the line that writes a one-step plan to edit.

matched.description: The query words this match carries.

bulk.description: The one call that replaces a loop of calls of this one.

executable_native.description: Steps only: whether `flow run` executes it (else only the Flow page does).
